nom: VANICREAM Enhanced Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid & Ceramides

avis.texte: My dermatologist recommended Vanicream amongst the list of moisturizers for the very dry body skin. However, I cannot use Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer on my face because it's so sticky! I can't imagine applying foundation of any kind to my face after the application of this moisturizer.

Pros: This hydrates my skin extremely well, and that says something because I live in a desert climate. It comes in a convenient bottle with a pump top, so I don't waste product, which is important. Cons: It's a very thin consistency, which I don't love. It also takes quite awhile to absorb into my skin. It's not exactly greasy, but sits on top for longer than I like. Even so, those cons are still worth it for how well it works.

Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer is Vanicream's modern upgrade to classic body and face lotions. It bridges the gap between their ultra-basic heavy tub cream and lightweight facial serums. While classic Vanicream relies almost entirely on petrolatum to block moisture loss, the Enhanced formula packs active skin barrier restorers into a silky, lightweight lotion designed for head-to-toe daily use. Key Highlights & Upgrades 5 Key Ceramides + Hyaluronic Acid: Unlike the standard cream, this adds ceramides (NP, AP, EOP, NG, AS) and sodium hyaluronate alongside glycerin to actually rebuild the skin barrier and pull water into the skin. Head-to-Toe Friendly: Works well on both the body and the face without clogging pores (non-comedogenic). Ultra-Clean Sensitive Formula: Free of fragrance, dyes, parabens, lanolin, essential oils, and botanical extracts. Texture: Silky, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly—far less heavy than the classic tub cream, but slightly richer than their traditional daily body lotion.

Wow, I am thoroughly impressed by this product. Vanicream Enhanced Moisturized surpassed my expectations. When I first tried it, the light yet creamy feel surprised me. I loved how it applied to my skin and wasn't greasy. It softened my skin immediately and had a very subtle pleasant smell. I love that it is safe for my sensitive skin!

I live in the desert and have dry skin. This is the only lighter weight lotion that actually works like a cream without the heavy cream feel. My skin needs cream but in the summer with hot 100+ degree heat creams are too heavy. Not this lotion! It moisturizes like a cream but with the weight of a lotion. Magical! My new go too!

avis.titre: Vanicream just keeps getting better and better
avis.texte: I FINALLY got my hands on a bottle of this stuff after seeing it online. After having such a great experience with the vanicream daily face moisturizer I wanted to try this for both my body and face. It is definitely lightweight, but it still moisturizes very well and leaves my skin soft. Even when I used it on my face my skin just felt so comfortable like it got a drink of water vs clogged and greasy like some other "2-in-1 body and face lotions" on the market will leave you feeling. I would even say my face loves this more than the vanicream face moisturizer! Overall both this and the daily face moisturizer are great products, and I will be repurchasing the enhanced body moisturizer for sure once I run out!

avis.titre: Good for some things but not others
avis.texte: This is very lightweight, and does indeed moisturize well. however, I've found that personally, I can only use it on certain areas of my body. If I use it on places like my back, shoulders, and upper arms, it doesn't absorb well and leaves me feeling sticky, especially if I put clothes on over it. I'm using it mostly as a hand and foot lotion, and it works really well for that.

The product is super light weight which I liked. The longevity of it though much better than most light weight creams I have used before but could be better but I understand as it is light weight. I use it as a body lotion after shower and it keeps me hydrated for a good amount of time.
This was an ok product .my skin was a little softer as I used it

I used this with my legs after shaving to prevent any drying, I use it daily to help keep my legs moisturized! This works very well and I would get it again when I use it all! Thanks for allowing me to try this!

avis.titre: Good for a light weight moisturizer.
avis.texte: This is a good light weight everyday moisturizer. It is fragrance free and good for sensitive skin. However, I did find the lotion a bit watery and typically like a thicker moisturizer. I think this would be a good everyday option for summer.
I wanted to wait a couple weeks to leave this review so i can give a honest one! I really do like the lotion it's very hydrating and leaves skin smooth. It's not oily which I appreciate
Love this the most due to its light weight nature. Goes on light, absorbs, protects, and is hardly noticeable it's on.

avis.titre: Perfect choice for a summer moisturizer
avis.texte: I love that the vanicream is light, non-greasy and easily absorbs into my skin. My husband has sensitive skin and he tried moisturizer also and felt that it worked well for his skin. It's perfect for the summers in Chicago but I would need to supplement for our harsh winters

I've been using this on my 4 year old who has sensitive skin with occasional eczema flare ups. This moisturizer has a thinner consistency which I find it good for warmer weather. Her skin does well with it and she hasn't had any dry patches while using it. But due to the thinner consistency, I don't think it would be enough moisture once the weather gets colder.

In order to ensure the effectiveness of the product, I have taken my time to evaluate it. I have recently tried Vanicream moisturizer, and I must say that it has exceeded my expectations. I have never been able to find a cream that effectively moisturizes my sensitive skin. The moisturizer does not leave my skin feeling dry. It contains hydraulic acid, is fragrance-free, and is non-greasy. My skin has undergone a significant transformation. It used to feel tight, and I had dry patches around my nose that have completely disappeared.

avis.titre: Definitely a good product to try!
avis.texte: I've been using Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer for a few weeks and I'm really impressed. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and provides long-lasting hydration without feeling greasy. My skin is sensitive and prone to irritation, but this moisturizer leaves it feeling soft, smooth, and comfortable all day. I also love that it's fragrance-free and contains hyaluronic acid and ceramides to help support the skin barrier. A little goes a long way, and the pump bottle makes it easy to use. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a gentle, effective daily moisturizer!
A very lightweight, scent free and moisturizing product! I was pleasantly surprised by the effectiveness and how long my skin looks hydrated and smooth. I definitely recommend!

It was such a lightweight non greasy formula it was easy to be added to my daily routine. I'm not one for lotion on my hands but this didn't leave a greasy thick feeling. It kept my skin hydrated but not clogged.

avis.titre: Not as hydrating as I hoped.
avis.texte: This is a very thin moisturizer when applying, and it doesn't feel very hydrating. I work in Healthcare, so I appreciate that it doesn't have a scent or any nasty ingredients. However, I need something more nourishing.
Very pleasant feeling the skin, light and smooth, not at all greasy. No odor. Leaves my skin feeling hydrated and soft all day.

I received this vani cream moisturizer complimentary from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Vanicream enhanced Moisturizer, and it has quickly become part of my everyday skincare routine. The texture is lightweight and absorbs nicely without feeling greasy or heavy on my skin. It provides just the right amount of hydration and leaves my skin feeling soft and comfortable throughout the day.

I have sensitive, dry skin that can get irritated easily, so I'm always careful with moisturizers. Vanicream™ Enhanced Moisturizer feels really soothing and hydrating without being heavy or greasy. I like that it doesn't have fragrance and doesn't make my skin burn or feel uncomfortable. It leaves my skin feeling soft, calm, and moisturized, especially when my skin barrier feels dry or stressed. This is a great everyday moisturizer if you want something gentle, simple, and effective.

Ive been hearing great things about vanicream for a while and Im loving it. I get super dry and itchy skin on the back of my arms and this is so hydrating. No scent and non irritating. Makes dry tired skin look and feel refreshed. Will definitely be continuing using and recommending

I've been really enjoying this moisturizer lately. It feels lightweight but still keeps my skin hydrated all day without any greasy residue. My skin tends to be sensitive, and this formula hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts. I love that it contains ceramides and hyaluronic acid to support the skin barrier while providing lasting moisture. It's become an easy, reliable staple in my daily skincare routine.

avis.titre: Non-Greasy, Unscented, and Great for Dry Skin!
avis.texte: This moisturizer is for when you don't care about smelling like a tropical paradise or a frosted sugar cookie or a romantic walk on the beach. This is for when what you need is a moisturizer/lotion that will actually make your dry hands feel smooth and soft instead of like the bark on a tree. I love that this is scent free and that it is safe for sensitive skin. Our Midwest winters are long, cold, and dry, and chapped/cracked hands are practically unavoidable. I would put this right up there with brands like Lubriderm, CeraVe, and Eucerin. My hands felt soft and moisturized after using and best of all, this is not sticky or greasy. Recommend! Thank you to Vanicream for the free Enhanced Moisturizer to try and to review!

As someone who suffers from dry skin, I am so happy to have found the Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer! This moisturizer is soothing, leaves my skin feeling hydrated, and lasts longer than most other moisturizers. I appreciate that it does not feel greasy.

I loved using this Vanicream moisturizer. It's lightweight and non greasy feeling in the skin but still feels hydrating which is perfect for summer. I also liked that it was gentle enough for my baby to use as well.

This is exactly as advertised on the bottle - lightweight yet hydrating. I love the fact that it's scent-free so I can layer my favorite perfume sprays without having to compete with another fragrance. This is great for all over the whole body.

I've been using Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer for several days now, and I'm impressed with how hydrating it feels without being heavy. The formula is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a greasy residue. My skin feels soft, smooth, and moisturized after each use. I appreciate the fragrance-free formula since I prefer products that are simple and gentle. The pump packaging is also a nice touch and makes application easy. Overall, this is a great everyday moisturizer that delivers hydration while feeling comfortable on the skin. I highly recomend this for everyone who has the sensitive skin !

avis.titre: I never knew moisturizer could feel like this
avis.texte: It's light and very moisturizing, and it fixes every dry patch for me instantly and lasts the whole day!

Vanicream kindly gave me their Enhanced Moisturizer for my review. I have been using the moisturizer for the past few weeks and felt an immediate improvement of the texture of my arms and legs. My arms and legs are rough from keratosis pilaris. This moisturizer is great at making my skin feel soft and bumps less noticeable. I've used many creams for my skin condition and they are usually thick and smell bad. I like that the cream is very lightweight and not greasy with no fragrance. I love the way it is easily dispensed also. Great moisturizer!

I have been using this moisturizer for a few weeks now, and it is hands down the best I've ever tried. It is incredibly lightweight but deeply hydrating, thanks to the hyaluronic acid and ceramides. It absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue and sits perfectly under makeup. If you have sensitive, allergy-prone, or easily irritated skin, you need this in your routine. 10/10 recommend!
I've taken awhile to try this and I love it.. it nourishes without leaving you oily or greasy. It absorbs into your skin great, not to thick or to watery.
This moisturizer was very hydrating- very gentle! No irritation and soothing to the skin!!

The instant the cream touches my skin i am instantly hydrated. The texture is really smooth and creamy. It does not leave my skin feeling sticky or oily. My skin is getting more mature everyday so the huge drink of hydration that it craved is satisfied with this cream. I would recommend to anyone needing a heavier moisturizer than something light weight.

Love this product! Just started using it about a month ago as an alternative to COSRX's barrier moisturizer and am hooked. I use it on my face, and my skin feels so moisturized! It is formulated to sensitive skin, but I think this product would work great on dry skin (I have combo skin). When I use this at night, or pair with an active, my skin retains its moisture till the next wash. Love it!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again, but it isn't my favorite
avis.texte: This is a good moisturizer for anyone with sensitive/dehydrated skin, but I have used and enjoyed a few other moisturizers more in the past. It is good, but I think there are a few better ones on the market. Leaves no residue or film on the skin and does moisturize, but I think in the middle of winter this wouldn't be enough for my skin.

I've struggled to find a moisturizer that hydrates my skin without causing irritation, but this one has been amazing. I use it daily, morning and night, and it keeps my skin feeling soft, smooth, and moisturized all day long. It absorbs well, isn't greasy, and works great under makeup. I also appreciate that it's gentle on sensitive skin and doesn't have a strong fragrance. A little goes a long way, making the bottle last quite a while. Since switching to this moisturizer, my skin feels healthier and looks more hydrated. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable, gentle moisturizer that actually delivers results.

I rarely try other brands of lotions/moisturizer's as depending on the season my skin dries out easily. This moisturizer works well! It's not super oily but it does leave a temporary film feeling on the hands but it goes away after a while which I like since I hate having that long lasting sticky oily feeling. I'm constantly washing my hands and surprisingly the moisturizer lasted about 2-3 washes before it came off and I had to reapply.
I have super dry hands from work and this has been the only moisturizer that has been able to heal my hands and not make them worse. If you have tried everything else, try this! It works!

This moisturizer is great for both face and body. It absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and keeps my skin soft and hydrated all day. It is gentle on my skin, has a pleasant scent, and does not feel greasy. I would definitely recommend it for daily use

The size of this product was the first shocker. When I first used this product my skin instantly felt hydrated and alive . I highly recommend this product to anyone with sensitive skin or acne prone. It's a game changer !

My skin is super dry. I love to use it for every purpose. I wouldn't say it has hydrated for 24 hrs exactly but with reapplication I believe it can cure the dryness. I am in LOVE with this product. It has everything you need. It's a lightweight lotion with the best ingredients. Also, a great price point. This is now a bathroom staple for me. I would recommend this to everyone.

So I'm living in NJ and as people now there weather its still cold on some days and i have dry skin for which i have to constantly use any moisturiser for my hands and i found it perfect for this kind of weather , its soft , and gives a perfectly moisturised look Would definitely recommend it

WOW. I had heard of all of the great things Vanicream does for your skin, but when I tell you I was absolutely Blown away by the effectiveness of this product! I even used it on my (v sensitive) face!

avis.titre: Put the Lotion on the Skin

The formula is free of unnecessary irritants, yet it provides excellent hydration and keeps my skin feeling soft and comfortable all day. Off the top this moisturizer actually moisturized it doesn't leave the skin oily. I just wish it had a better scent.

It's got hyaluronic acid, 5 key ceramides, and glycerin and makes your skin noticeably softer and more plump with continued use.

I got the Vanicream sensitive skin moisturizer for free through buzz agent so what did I have to loose. I honestly was not impressed. I've also been using the Vanicream for two weeks and my hands are still shot. Overall I would recommend something else and would not buy this product on my own.
We have been using vanicream for years for eczema and this off the best one yet. Definitely will continue buying! It even helped improve the stretch marks on my stomach!

I used this moisturizer in the morning and the evening. I loved how lightweight and fragrance free the moisturizer felt. The bottle is a big bottle and is going to last a while as a little bit of moisturizer goes a long way

I was hesitant not knowing much about Vanicream. My son and myself both have sensitive skin. So we shop around to find something that suits us without all the perfumes. I will definitely be getting another bottle just for the child.

My skin absolutely drinks this lotion in—it feels incredibly rich and luxurious without any greasy residue. After just a couple of weeks, I'm already noticing a real difference: my dryness is improving, and the crepiness is starting to visibly smooth out.

I have very dry skin. This moisturizer was a little too light for me but I appreciated that it's fragrance free and targeted for sensitive skin. I will continue to buy this knowing it's safe for my whole family.
I used this product daily after a bath and throughout the day. I throughly enjoyed that this moisturizer had no scent and completely vanished into my skin with no white cast left behind.

I have really dry skin and this didn't help much. I applied it in the morning before work and would have visible dry skin by the time I got to work. I feel like it's a little watery compared to the lotions I normally use as well.

I was hesitant to make this review quickly. At first I thought want sure if it was going to keep me moisturized all day or if it would be absorbed too quickly and leave me feeling like SpongeBob in Sandy's home. That was not the case. It exceeded my expectations. It's a thin, non greasy powerhouse of a moisturizer. I'm excited to try it on my toddler that has eczema.

It feels light, absorbs quickly, and keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy. It's fragrance-free, gentle on sensitive skin, and hasn't caused any irritation. The pump bottle is convenient, and a little goes a long way. If you want a simple moisturizer that just works, this is a solid choice
I love vanicream products. I know I can safely use it on my eczema prone kids. It's very moisturizing and doesn't smell. Would purchase again for my kids. It's also not expensive so always a plus
This cream/moisturizer is really nice it has a lighter/runny texture. But it is very moisture and a little goes a long way. It provides a lot of moisture and no white cast. Absolutely no irritations.
I absolutely love this lotion it is really lightweight and very moisturizing and the scent is not over powering which is a great thing I definitely recommend this so anyone that suffers from dry skin

Vanicream is a stable item in my household as a sensitive skin girly. It's gentle and hydrating on the skin without any breakouts or burning feeling on the skin which most lotions give me. I trust this product on my skin so much because I've had nothing but great results!

avis.titre: I would absolutely purchase this product again
avis.texte: ★★★★★ 5 Stars I've tried a lot of moisturizers over the years, especially because I have sensitive skin, and Vanicream's Enhanced Moisturizer has quickly become one of my favorites. Compared to other products I've used, this moisturizer feels much lighter on the skin while still providing deep, lasting hydration. Many moisturizers either feel greasy or sit on top of the skin, but this one absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and comfortable all day. One of the biggest benefits is that it's gentle enough for sensitive skin while still being incredibly effective. I love that it contains hyaluronic acid, ceramides, and glycerin to help support the skin barrier and lock in moisture. It works well on both my face and body, doesn't clog my pores, and layers nicely under makeup. As someone with sensitive skin, I also appreciate that it doesn't contain fragrances, essential oils, or unnecessary irritants. I would absolutely purchase this product again. It's become an easy addition to my daily skincare routine because it provides reliable hydration without causing irritation or breakouts. I would definitely recommend this moisturizer to friends and family, especially anyone with sensitive, dry, or easily irritated skin. It's gentle, effective, and delivers exactly what it promises. If you're looking for a lightweight moisturizer that keeps your skin hydrated and healthy-looking, this is a great option.

I've used Vanicream in the past but this formula is AMAZING! The first time I used it, I said outloud "my skin is drinking this up". It made my husband interested and even he loved how it felt on his face. It's now a must have in my skincare routine. You can feel the hydration when you put it on. It doesn't leave you feeling greasy, it leaves your skin feeling HYDRATED.

Light weight, absorbing good, no smell. No greasy feeling at all. We started with the hands to test first. Kept our hand soft, moisture all day. Since this moisturizer can be use full body. We tried on our face to test out the moisturizer level. To be honest, we love using as facial moisturizer instead the body. I have gotten my mother to try out this product too. She loves it! Thanks for giving us an opportunity to try out new products.

It's a great product vanicream cream. What i like is no the kind moisturizer leave your skin greasy. It's un scent so i think is good for summer. I have a sensitive skin and did not have any problem with the product.

I noticed I was reaching for another moisturizer almost immediately. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I love how light this lotion is. It makes application so much faster but of how quick and easy it is to spread. It kept my skin moisturize and I didn't notice any itchy dry skin after the first use. It doesn't have a scent or any fragrance making it for my whole family, including my little ones with more sensitive skin. It's not sticky or tacky and absorbs very fast. The pump bottle is also very convenient.

I was really happy to receive a free sample of the Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer. I've never tried this brand but have always heard good things. It is so light and moisturizing and blended right into my skin. What surprised me the most was that there was no greasy after feel especially on my hands. It has become my new daily moisturizer!
I have used this cream for the past couple of weeks and I like it because it is great for sensitive skin, it absorbs quickly into the skin and it feels moisturized.

As someone with dry skin, finding a product that actually locks in moisture all day can be a challenge, but this one does the trick. It has easily become a staple in my routine. It feels lightweight but deeply hydrating, and the fact that it's scent-free is a massive bonus for anyone sensitive to fragrances.

avis.titre: New addition to skin care routine
avis.texte: I have been using the moisturizer for about 3 weeks now and I have seen a great change. As some background my skin is very sensitive to perfumes and certain makeup. I also have eczema and flare-ups that cause flaky skin. Since using the Vanicream moisturizer I have noticed a reduction in the flakiness on my skin and less redness. I have also started wearing it as a base for my tinted moisturizer and it held up quite well

I was using the big tub of vanicream moisturizer before this and I always thought it was a little too thick for my face. But this enhanced moisturizer is perfect! Not too thick, isn't sticky, and it hasn't irritated my sensitive skin! Highly recommend if you like the original vanicream.

avis.titre: Gentle enough for my kids too!
avis.texte: I've always been nervous about what I put on my kids' skin, so when I found this Moisturizer, it felt like a win. Now I use it on myself, my 3-year-old, and my 5-year-old without any hesitation. What I love most is how gentle it feels. There's no heavy greasy feeling, no weird residue. It just soaks in and leaves skin soft and lightly hydrated. It's not one of those thick creams that sits on top of your skin. It's fragrance-free and doesn't have all those irritating stuff that can bug sensitive skin. For my kids, especially when winter hits and their skin gets cranky, this is perfect. It does exactly what it says it will do, nothing more, nothing less. Honestly, I'm just relieved to have one moisturizer that works for all of us. One less product to think about, and I feel good about what's going on their skin.

I HATE lotion! It makes me feel so gross but this stuff is fantastic! It is so hydrating but dries instantly and leaves your skin silky smooth! I'm so glad I finally found something that works and also doesn't have harmful ingredients! 10/10 would recommend!!

I received Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer as part of a free product offer in exchange for providing an honest review. After using it for a couple weeks, I've been very impressed with its lightweight non-greasy formula and effective hydration. Ive always had struggles finding lotions that didnt irritate my skin, or cause breakouts, so very happy I tried this and have had great results so far. This is going to be a staple in my skincare routine moving forward

I love this. It's kinda thick but not greasy. We have used this brand in the past for our daughter. I love that this is an all over cream. Helper mainly on my fave which is what I was using it on. I have not gotten any break outs. Love that it's not greasy or oily feeling after using

avis.titre: I would buy this product again

avis.titre: Finally a non greasy hydrating lotion!
avis.texte: Great non greasy lotion. Provides super hydration. I usually find lotions that provide hydration are so greasy and linger on your skin after application. This provides the nutrients and hydration my skin needs without the greasy feeling!

I have searched high and low for a base moisturizer for under make up or just for day to day use. This one is perfect! It absorbs wonderfully and doesn't leave you feeling heavy or greasy. I've noticed my skin feeling more alive and better than ever. Will certainly be adding it to my regular routine.

The Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer works great at giving my skin the moisture it needs without being heavy or greasy feeling. It works great on even sensitive skin like mine and my daughters who have eczema. It also doesn't clog my pores which I love.
I absolutely love this moisturizer. I already ordered another bottle before I'm the first one was finished. I use it on my kids and even on my face. So light weight and it leaves such a nice glow!!!

I've been really impressed with this moisturizer. The formula feels lightweight but still deeply hydrating, and it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth and calm without any greasy residue. I have sensitive skin, so I appreciate that it's gentle, fragrance-free and doesn't cause irritation or breakouts. It layers beautifully with the rest of my skincare routine and keeps my skin hydrated all day. The pump packaging is also super convenient and hygienic. Definitely a new staple in my routine!

I love the other vanicream products I use daily so I know I was going to love this. I love that it's not greasy and have hyaluronic acid and ceramides and it doesn't have toxic stuff and great for sensitive skin

I am using this Vani cream from a while and being a dry skin person, it has been a great addition to my skin care. It gives long lasting hydration and very light weight. Not greasy and sticky at all. I will highly recommend to give it a try.

The Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer is wonderful as a body lotion. The ingredients made me think I could use it for my face as well but it was a bit heavy for the face, particularly under makeup. The Vanicream moisturizer isn't heavily scented and filled with synthetic fragrances. It's not a thick moisturizer but absorbs fast and keeps the skin hydrated. Cracks in my hands disappeared after one use.

Vanicream™ Enhanced Moisturizer has been such a great addition to my skincare routine. The formula feels rich and nourishing without being greasy or heavy on my skin. avis.titre: Easy to use, light, gentle. Great everyday moisturizer.
avis.texte: Thank you Vanicream for the opportunity to review this excellent product. Though I usually prefer cream for my sensitive skin, this moisturizer was a nice change since it was so light and easy to apply. I LOVE the pump at top, which is sometimes hard to find. It doesn't release too much at a time so I can get the exact amount I need at any given moment. I'm also thrilled this is sensitive enough to use on my toddler as well, so that I don't have to buy multiple products. I will likely purchase this again and bring into my daily routine.

I have started using this moisturizer daily and nightly. It has became a part of my routine. It provides rich moisturizer to my skin and body. I love that it is fragrance free making it suitable for sensitive skin!

Finding a moisturizer for sensitive skin is tough, but Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer is a total game-changer. It is incredibly lightweight, absorbs fast, and provides deep hydration without any greasy residue. I love that it is completely fragrance-free and gentle. It wears beautifully all day and has become a staple in my routine.

avis.titre: A Must for Dry and Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I'm giving this product a 10. It doesn't have a scent, so for those that are sensitive to smell it's a great. Moisturizing properties: My skin is very dry, and it was kind of grey on some spots. I always apply it after bath, and it moisturizers and feels good on my body. I recommend buy this product because it does every thing it sets out to do: lightweight, hydrates (has hyaluronic acid and ceramides), fragrance free. I absolutely would recommend this product to friends and family as it's very efficient.

avis.titre: Honestly best moisturizer my family has tried
avis.texte: My husband has psoriasis and we've tried so many different lotions & creams and this has been the fastest most impactful positive change he has seen in such a short time with so little effort.

I have tried several moisturizers for sensitive skin, but Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer has surprised me for how light and effective it is. It absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feeling and keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day. I like that it contains hyaluronic acid and ceramides, ingredients that help strengthen the skin barrier and keep it soft and healthy. After several days of use, I noticed my skin more hydrated, comfortable and with less feeling of dryness. In addition, it did not cause irritation or outbreaks, something very important for my sensitive skin. Yes, I would buy this product again because it delivers what it promises and offers long-lasting hydration. I would also recommend it to family and friends, especially those with sensitive skin and are looking for a soft but effective moisturizer."

I love this it's very lightweight & non fragrance so it's great for sensitive skin. It's light for pores which is really good if you have huge pores big plus so it can be used on face. It also doesn't feel greasy

avis.titre: I would be hesitant to buy this product again
avis.texte: The pump does not work; therefore, it's annoying to unscrew the pump to get to the moisturizer. I would use the product more if the pump worked!

I apply after the shower and there is not that typical greasy or sticky feeling that most moisturizers give. I also have sensitive skin and this seems to work for me wonderfully! I haven't had any unexpected issues pop up. Something to note is that it is a thinner formula. I am not used to that but I don't hate it.

avis.titre: Finally a product that moisturizes without a greasy feeling!
avis.texte: I received this item for free in exchange for my honest review. Honestly, this moisturizer blows the other brands I've tried out of the water. Usually, creams that claim to be "for sensitive skin" still end up stinging or making me break out because of hidden fragrances. This one is completely different—it gives me tons of hydration without any of the heavy, greasy weight.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I was asked to try/review this product. It is a light/smooth lotion, and a little goes a long way. My skin felt quite nice afterward with a slight sticky feeling, but nothing too bothersome. I like it!

I was given this product for free to review. However I absolutely love it! I did a micro needling session and this has helped heal my skin perfectly! I apply 2xs daily and my skin looks so fresh and smooth all day! Very lightweight and non sticky.

I was very surprised on how well this lotion worked as it was lighter than I thought it would be. I have rosacea and very dry sensitive skin so I was hesitant to try it. I did not have a reaction at all. After a few days the dry skin around my mouth had cleared up. I would recommend this for anyone with sensitive skin for both your body and face.

avis.titre: Finally, a moisturizer that actually works for dry skin
avis.texte: I have struggled with dry skin for years and have gone through more moisturizers than I can count. Most either sit on top without absorbing, leave a greasy residue, or wear off within a few hours. The Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer does none of that. It absorbs quickly, does not feel heavy, and my skin stays hydrated throughout the day without needing to reapply. Compared to other drugstore and mid-range options I have tried, this one holds up. The formula is clean and straightforward, which matters to me since fragrance and unnecessary additives have irritated my skin in the past. I would absolutely buy this again and have already recommended it to a few people in my family who deal with the same dryness issues. If you have dry skin and have been bouncing between products that never quite deliver, this is worth trying.

To start this review, I want to say that I did get this product in exchange for an honest review. That said, I am being 100% authentic and honest when I say this is worth the purchase and I will be buying this moisturizer again when I run out. I have very dry skin and deal with eczema year round. I have large patches on my underarms and upper thighs, and while this didn't solve or take away my eczema, it didn't irritate my skin further, which has been the case for most products lately. Paired with my relief cream, this Vanicream moisturizer soothed my skin more than any lotion I've used in a long time. I deal with small bumps and extensive eczema on my hands and this has helped to minimize those issues while moisturizing. Honestly the results I've had with my hands is the star of the product to me personally. This product is marketed for face, body, hands- the whole shebang and I agree that it works for it all. I tried this as a face moisturize and, for my dry skin, I felt that it did an okay job moisturizing but I need more of a cream personally. That's a personal preference/need issue though. Oh and it has no added scents which is a huge plus!! I'm super sensitive to scents and this being scent free has allowed me to use it whenever wherever and I love it. All in all 5/5 ⭐️'s from me!!

I love how deeply moisturizing this lotion is. I have extremely dry skin and I've been on the lookout for the most nourishing lotion, and I think I found it with this one. I also love that there is no scent.

I'm so happy to have the opportunity to try Vanicream's Enhanced Moisturizer. This brand has been around for years but this is my first time using this product. I like that it has ceramides and Hyaluronic Acid as ingredients. I applied the lotion to my hands and all over my body daily. It isn't greasy and absorbs quickly. The moisturizer is lightweight and rich. The first thing I noticed was how my dry skin on my hands and legs felt smooth and hydrated. It doesn't leave any residue. I didn't experience any irritation either. In comparison to my usual body moisturizer this one by Vanicream is outstanding. I will be purchasing it from now on because of the long lasting hydration and improving the way my skin looks in just a few days. I received this product for free from Buzzagent to test and review.

I received this product for free in exchange of my honest review I really like this moisturizer. I use it for my face morning and night and it didn't break me out and it gives me enough hydration. I love the way it absorbs into the skin. It's lightweight and it doesn't feel greasy and also it's fragrance free. The size is super great and it's affordable.

I've been using this moisturizer for a few days now, and I'm very impressed with the hydration it provides. It leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and moisturized without any greasy residue once absorbed. It may feel slightly sticky at first, but that quickly goes away as it dries. Overall, it's a great product for keeping skin hydrated, and I will definitely purchase it again.
I love the product. It's a very moisturizing lotion. I love that there is no scent to this lotion

I had very dry skin all around and this absorbs quickly into the skin, and leaves my skin so soft all day! It has no scent, and I love how my skin has improved with it so far! I will definitely be recommending this moisturizer to everyone!

This Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer is very moisturizing. It is a thinner consistency that absorbs very quickly into the skin and leaves your skin feeling very hydrated. I love that it is non-comedogenic and dermatologist recommended. I have sensitive skin and have been using for over a week and have not had any negative reactions. It wears great under makeup and does not feel heavy at all on the face. I would buy this product again and would definitely recommend to any family and friends who have dry skin.

Finally found a moisturizer that feels lightweight but actually keeps my skin hydrated. This Vanicream Enhanced Moisturizer absorbs quickly, layers well under makeup/SPF, and doesn't leave my skin irritated or greasy at all. Love that it has hyaluronic acid + ceramides without a bunch of unnecessary fragrance or harsh ingredients. My skin has been feeling softer, calmer, and more balanced since using it. I know it's a moisturizer, but I've found it to be great not only for my face but for my hands and legs as well. I really have enjoyed this product.

This lotion worked really well for my sensitive skin- it didn't cause any flat ups. If you have normal (not dry) skin, I think it could be your go-to moisturizer. I have very dry skin so it wasn't quite moisturizing enough for me. The consistency is great though- not greasy, not sticky, and absorbs fast.

Vanicream sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. I have been using it for 8 days now on my arms, legs, neck and face and it has surprisingly worked great! It goes on smooth and is lightweight. It keeps my skin hydrated all day without having to reapply(contains hyaluronic acid and ceramides). I was worried it would cause a breakout or pore clogging on my face, but it has not caused any issues and works better than my expensive face cream. Love that it's made without dyes, fragrance, parabens or formaldehyde. Will be buying as my go to daily lotion!
